episodes.title: Klamath Falls
episodes.summary: Colter's handlers, Velma and Teddi Bruin, send him to Klamath Falls, Ore., to investigate the disappearance of 14-year-old Gil Brown who is suspected to have been taken by his birth dad with a criminal background. While pursuing a lead at a local burger joint based on intel from tech genius Bobby Exley, Colter finds himself in some trouble of his own requiring help from legal mind Reenie Greene.

episodes.title: Missoula
episodes.summary: Colter tracks down a missing young man who has been pulled into a deadly cult and doesn't want to be found.

episodes.title: Springland
episodes.summary: As Colter helps a young woman locate her free-spirited sister, he digs deeper into how her last days may lead to a dark secret she unearthed in this tight-knit town.

episodes.title: Mt. Shasta
episodes.summary: Colter races against the clock to find the missing teenage son of Reenie's close friend Erika.

episodes.title: St. Louis
episodes.summary: The odds are stacked against Colter as he is tasked by a convicted murderer's teenage daughter to track down a missing witness who could prove her dad's innocence.

episodes.title: Lexington
episodes.summary: Colter reluctantly teams up with his nemesis, fellow reward seeker Billie Matalon, to track down a missing racehorse.

episodes.title: Chicago
episodes.summary: Colter, Bobby and Reenie race against time to track down a talented MMA fighter who disappeared while trying to solve her family's trouble with their visas.

episodes.title: Camden
episodes.summary: Colter tracks down a dockworker who went missing two weeks before his wedding.

episodes.title: Aurora
episodes.summary: When a widower offers a reward to find his only daughter who disappeared three years ago and is presumed dead, Colter agrees to help track her down.

episodes.title: Into the Wild
episodes.summary: Colter journeys into the wilderness of Idaho to track down the owner of an aerial outfitting company's missing adult children, and friends of Reenie's father, who were last seen in a plane that took off during bad weather.

episodes.title: Beyond the Campus Walls
episodes.summary: When a grad student goes missing after a house party, his friends and family believe he buckled under the pressure of his research grant; Colter uncovers a dangerous -- and deadly -- conspiracy.

episodes.title: Off the Books
episodes.summary: Colter is forced to team up with his estranged brother, who enlists his help to track down a former army buddy who's gone missing after several weeks of paranoid behavior.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.summary: Colter investigates the disappearance of two amateur storm chasers that the local police have written off as an accidental drowning; Colter's expert tracking skills lead him to uncover the seedy underbelly of a small town resort.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: The disappearance of a family in the backwoods of Arkansas leads Colter to a shocking discovery; Reenie opens up her new law firm and enlists Velma's help in setting up shop.

episodes.title: Ontological Shock
episodes.summary: When Colter suddenly disappears during his search for a missing father, Reenie recruits his brother, Russell, for help.

episodes.title: Bloodlines
episodes.summary: Colter and rival rewardist Billie Matalon team up to find a missing high school baseball star.

episodes.title: Noble Rot
episodes.summary: Reenie gets Colter to take a case involving a woman missing from a high-end wellness retreat.

episodes.title: Preternatural
episodes.summary: Colter takes a job locating a missing teen with a unique spiritual gift in an inhospitable mining town.

episodes.title: Trust Fall
episodes.summary: While searching for missing campers, Colter meets a retired police officer who believes a serial killer is on the loose.

episodes.title: Man's Best Friend
episodes.summary: When Colter finds a lost dog at a gas station in Denver and the dog is subsequently stolen from his truck, Colter makes it his mission to track him down and reunite him with his family.

episodes.title: The Night Movers
episodes.summary: Colter is tasked with tracking down a man who seemingly died in a car accident months earlier; Colter catches a break in his white whale case.

episodes.title: The Disciple
episodes.summary: A new lead in Colter's white whale case, the disappearance of Gina Picket, brings him and retired cop Keaton back together to track down a serial killer.

episodes.title: Nightingale
episodes.summary: After Colter is hired to find a missing singer linked to a violent crime, he discovers his target is a stoic survivalist, not unlike himself.

episodes.title: Shades of Gray
episodes.summary: While tracking the son of a prominent New Jersey cupcake chain founder, Colter gets thrust into the middle of a violent mafia war.

episodes.title: Monster
episodes.summary: Colter is hired to find a mother in Ohio who went missing after tucking her son in for the night.

episodes.title: Neptune
episodes.summary: Colter travels to New York City to find a woman who vanished in the dressing room of an upscale clothing store.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.summary: When a teenage musician vanishes in New Orleans, Colter teams up with a local detective and uncovers a chilling mystery involving dark magic.

episodes.title: The Grey Goose
episodes.summary: Colter recruits fellow rewardist Billie Matalon to infiltrate a women's prison in order to gain access to critical information that would help track down an escaped prisoner and her hostage.

episodes.title: The Mercy Seat
episodes.summary: Colter helps an old friend with a search and rescue mission for two missing sisters in the snowy Montana wilderness. Meanwhile, Reenie gets a visit from a new client that challenges her morality.

episodes.title: Memories
episodes.summary: Randy enlists Colter's services for his ex after her best friend goes missing following a night on the town in Reno.

episodes.title: Collision
episodes.summary: Colter heads to Willow Creek, Mich., after a worried mother hires him to track down her beauty queen daughter, Riley, who vanished while driving home from work. While investigating at the garden center where Riley works, Colter looks into her modeling past and uncovers that she was hiding a major secret.

episodes.title: Rules of the Game
episodes.summary: When Reenie's client, Leo Sharf, hires Colter to track down his missing assistant before his company launch, the case takes a personal turn and Reenie becomes entangled in a deadly vendetta threatening both of their lives. Also, Colter visits his sister, Dory.

episodes.title: Echo Ridge
episodes.summary: Colter returns to Echo Ridge to investigate a diner owner's disappearance, only to uncover a kidnapping ring and a shocking family secret.

episodes.title: The Process
episodes.summary: As Colter grapples with the shocking truth surrounding his father's death, Russell joins forces with his brother to help track down the missing wife and daughter of one of Reenie's clients.

episodes.title: Leverage
episodes.summary: After discovering they've disrupted a sinister underground operation called The Process, Colter and Russell must race to find the source behind these chained events and end it once and for all.

episodes.title: First Fire
episodes.summary: On Halloween night, when a nurse is murdered and arsonist Heston Koontz disappears from a psychiatric facility, Colter follows a trail of unsettling clues to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: No Man's Land
episodes.summary: When a man disappears in a lawless desert town, Colter's investigation uncovers a hidden relationship that draws him into a dangerous power struggle – and leaves him facing the hard conditions of the wilderness.

episodes.title: The Old Ways
episodes.summary: Four teens vanish in the Santa Cruz Mountains, and Colter's search uncovers a hidden agenda.

episodes.title: Angel
episodes.summary: When a crime scene cleaner disappears, Colter discovers her fascination with true crime, which may have led her into dangerous territory; Colter uncovers a group of amateur sleuths whose hunt for a killer puts everyone at risk.

episodes.title: Eat the Rich
episodes.summary: When chasing down leads about his father's past, Colter meets a man desperate to find his daughter who vanished while working a courier route; Colter is pulled into an orbit of a wealthy family and their ruthless fixer.

episodes.title: Eurydice
episodes.summary: When a grieving mother becomes the prime suspect in her missing daughter's murder, Colter sets out to find the true culprit and prove her innocence.

episodes.title: Good Trouble
episodes.summary: When Colter's old friend Keaton asks for help finding his former partner, they uncover a trail of bodies and a conspiracy that runs deeper than they could've imagined.

episodes.title: The Fallout
episodes.summary: Injured and framed for a string of murders, Colter, cut off from Reenie and Randy, must rely on unexpected ally Billie to stop a relentless assassin, uncovering a murky truth where justice and vengeance blur.

episodes.title: To the Bone
episodes.summary: When an 18-year-old goes missing from his family's restaurant, Colter uncovers the teen's underground fake ID business and the secret life he's been hiding from his parents.

episodes.title: Do No Harm
episodes.summary: When a doctor vanishes after her shift, Colter uncovers a trail of stolen drugs and disguises revealing a calculated revenge plot.

episodes.title: Breakaway
episodes.summary: After Baxter, a veteran stuntman, disappears following a risky stunt, his girlfriend Laura calls Colter to investigate a B-movie set, uncovering shady producers and a trail that leads into a dangerous underground world.

episodes.title: The Field Trip
episodes.summary: When a young boy disappears during a school field trip at the aquarium, Colter must navigate a volatile father's desperation to find his son.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.summary: Randy enlists Colter's help when one of his closest friends vanishes while under house arrest.

episodes.title: Struck
episodes.summary: A pregnant wife reaches out to Colter to find her missing husband.

episodes.title: Daughters
episodes.summary: Colter is hired to find a teen girl who went missing from a friend's house during a tragic triple homicide.

episodes.title: Alaskan Wild
episodes.summary: While searching for answers about his father, Colter is pulled into a tense case involving a teenage boy's missing parents, uncovering a dangerous situation far more complicated than it first appears.

episodes.title: Chain of Custody
episodes.summary: Reenie hires Colter to locate the star witness of her and Maxine's lawsuit against a corrupt real estate developer on the eve of trial.

episodes.title: Reclamation
episodes.summary: Colter's search for a woman who went missing from a rehab facility takes an unexpected turn when he runs into Billie, uncovering a possible link between each of their cases.

episodes.title: Chrono Stasis
episodes.summary: Colter and Russell unite in a personal mission to uncover their father's mysterious work.

episodes.title: The Best Ones
episodes.summary: Colter and Russell search for a victim of a nefarious research project.

episodes.title: Safe Harbor
episodes.summary: Colter's search for a teenage boy's missing father leads him to a dangerous criminal operation at the Port of Los Angeles.
